title: Official public NVIDIA/open-gpu-kernel-modules consumer source evidence
identity_caveat: Matching public headers to tag 615.78.08 does not establish whole-binary identity. This report documents public text source only. No generated descriptor instances or firmware-slot roles inferred.

wpr2_addr_registers.note: NV_PFB_PRI_MMU_WPR2_ADDR_LO/HI macros public in dev_fb.h (gh100/tu102) and NV_HUBMMU_PRI_MMU_WPR2_ADDR_LO/HI in dev_hubmmu_base.h (gb100). No public .c reads/writes these registers (exhaustive grep of all fetched public C files). WPR2 offsets are filled in by ACR ucode at boot (kernel_gsp_gh100.c L386-L387). Register-level WPR2 consumers are NOT in public source.

subdeviceCtrlCmdFbGetWprRegionInfo_IMPL.note: Command NV2080_CTRL_CMD_FB_GET_WPR_REGION_INFO (0x20801364U) and NV2080_CTRL_FB_GET_WPR_REGION_INFO_PARAMS (wpr1Start/wpr1End/wpr2Start/wpr2End/fbRegionOfWpr2Start) are public in ctrl2080fb.h L3083-L3093. The IMPL body is NOT present in any public .c of tag ca2d03e (searched subdevice.c, all subdevice_ctrl_*.c, kernel_gsp.c, gsp arch, kern_gpu_arch_*.c, device.c, device_ctrl.c). Reported as explicitly unavailable.

gsp_wpr_setup.note: kgspPopulateWprMeta_GH100 (kernel_gsp_gh100.c L366-L471) populates GspFwWprMeta sizes (nonWprHeapSize, gspFwHeapSize, frtsSize, pmuReservedSize, vgaWorkspaceSize, bootloader/radix3 sizes) but the actual WPR offsets are filled by ACR ucode. _kgspBootGspRm (kernel_gsp.c L5428) calls kgspIsWpr2Up_HAL, kgspPopulateWprMeta_HAL, kgspBootstrap_HAL. kgspGetWprEndMargin_GH100 (kernel_gsp_gh100.c L1311-L1353) converts regkey MB->bytes via << 20.

bindata_nvucodes.note: BINDATA_STORAGE_PVT (bin_data_pvt.h L60-L67): actualSize/compressedSize/pData/flags/relOffset. NVUCODES header (L84-L114): magic 0x5345444F4355564E ('NVUCODES'), version 1, numEntries (unique per-file index embedded in gsp.bin), fingerprint (hash of filenames in index-order). bindataArchiveGetStorage (bin_data.c L135-L159) looks up by BINDATA_LABEL enum over entries[]. bindataGetBufferSize reads actualSize (L122). bindataWriteToBuffer reads pData (L49/L83); compressed reads use offset 0 via utilGzGetData, not relOffset. relOffset is documented but NOT read by any public bindata consumer (only zeroed in bindataDestroyStorage L289). g_bindata_pvt[] ordinal index starts from 1 (bin_data.c L260). No per-entry source name string in public struct.

raw_hi_to_api_end_conversion.note: kgspGetWprEndMargin_GH100 (kernel_gsp_gh100.c L1322): wprEndMargin = DRF_VAL(..._MB, wprEndMarginOverride) << 20, i.e. raw regkey in MB converted to bytes by << 20 (x1 MiB). Heap sizes also use << 20 (kernel_gsp.c L7312/L7315/L7423). No explicit '+page adjustment' found in public WPR end computation.

inclusive_exclusive_semantics.note: END is EXCLUSIVE. ctrl2080fb.h L3072-L3081 documents wpr1End/wpr2End as 'FB offset of the end (exclusive) of WPR1/WPR2'.

container_external_reloffset_actualsize_.note: actualSize IS read (bindataGetBufferSize -> bin_data.c L122). relOffset field present (bin_data_pvt.h L66, 'Offset of bin within bindata file') but NOT read by any public consumer in bin_data.c (reads use pData directly; compressed reads start at offset 0). Source index naming: lookup by BINDATA_LABEL enum / g_bindata_pvt ordinal (from 1); no source name string field in public struct.

unavailable: Actual gspFwWprStart/gspFwWprEnd offset computation (done by ACR ucode)
Per-entry source name string in bindata struct
verification: All files are verbatim public text from tag ca2d03e6fafd4d4b56b383497d931c25b283bfcf. SHA256 computed over saved byte content; immutable URLs allow re-verification. No source/config mutation, hardware access, key/signature handling, bypass, or binary loading performed.
